question: According to Park's classification, which of the following is an example of an INDIVIDUAL method of health education?

tipsAndFeedback.chosenFeedback: A village meeting is a group method — it reaches multiple people simultaneously, not one-to-one.
Correct. Door-to-door visits are an individual method — the health worker interacts with one person or household at a time, allowing tailored, two-way communication.
Radio broadcasts are a mass method — they reach large, undifferentiated audiences without direct interaction.
A puppet show is a group method used in community gatherings, not an individual approach.

overallFeedback.feedback: Review Park's three-tier classification: individual (one-to-one), group (small or large gatherings), and mass methods (media reaching wide audiences without personal contact).
Well done. Individual methods like home visits and counselling sessions allow personalised interaction and are most effective when behaviour change depends on personal circumstances.
